prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE production icon atlas for Elements - Icons. The supplied image is a STYLE REFERENCE; replace its subjects with the subjects specified here.
Rustic, earnest old-fashioned COLOURED WOODCUT. Match the supplied references' warm black, dull ochre, clay/rust red, slate blue, muted olive and creamy carved cuts, but visibly simpler and less polished than the first reference: a small number of broad confident cuts, occasional knife slips, uneven angular contours, slightly crooked handmade things, thin missed patches in ink and colour plates shifted slightly beyond or short of their black outlines. Imperfect registration must look printed, not blurred. No smooth gradients, modeled digital shading, tiny decorative hatching, glossy highlights, outline stickers, cute toy proportions, circular badges, frames or presentation shadows. Humble functional objects, easily recognised at 56 pixels. Natural, clear silhouettes before texture. Transparent outside each object.
EXACTLY FIVE columns and FOUR rows, 20 equal cells, wide 5:4 atlas. Keep every complete subject centered in its own cell with at least 15% TRANSPARENT MARGIN from all cell boundaries; strict grid with clear wide gutters. No labels or numbering, no drawn grid, no text except where explicitly requested. Do not repeat objects from the reference unless listed. Make the states of related objects clearly different, using silhouettes and visible contents.
READING ORDER:
1. Reservoir: Low rectangular brick-lined water basin viewed obliquely, clearly EMPTY ochre bottom
2. Waterwheel with jars: Vertical paddled wooden waterwheel with six small open ochre jars attached around its rim; one jar tipping a blue stream at the top
3. Filled reservoir: Same low rectangular brick-lined basin filled with slate-blue water near its rim
4. Water channel: Short raised open-topped wooden trough supported on two legs, EMPTY tan interior
5. Irrigation channel: Same open wooden trough visibly carrying a blue water stream, small outlet flow
6. Festival banner: Irregular rust-red and ochre patterned cloth banner hanging from a simple horizontal wooden pole
7. Canopy: Large cream cloth shade stretched overhead on four plain posts, four taut diagonal guy ropes
8. Dye: Small clay bowl of strong rust-red dye with a red flower beside it, no brush
9. Dyed cloth: Plain folded rust-red cloth with uneven colour coverage, no pattern
10. Loom: Simple upright wooden weaving frame with vertical cream warp threads and a small shuttle, no patterned cloth finished
11. Dyed thread: A hank of loose rust-red dyed thread with uneven pale strands, no spool
12. Patterned cloth: Folded woven cloth with a broad irregular rust-red and ochre diamond pattern and fringed edge
13. Awning: Cream cloth shade on a simple TWO-post timber support, loose edges, no guy ropes
14. Charcoal: Four black partly charred sticks with blunt broken ends, no grey ash pile
15. Printed invitations: Fan of three cream sheets all showing the SAME simple boat and shared-table printed emblem, no words
16. Mailboat: Same modest one-mast cream-sailed timber boat, visibly carrying a bundle of cream letters tied with red cord
17. Paper pulp: Shallow rough wooden vat of pale fibrous wet slurry with a small draining screen beside it
18. Paper: Three blank uneven cream paper sheets with deckled edges
19. Ink: Small open black ink pot with a broad black ink smear beside it, no brush
20. Printing block: Plain rectangular wooden printing block face-up, clearly CARVED recessed boat and table motif, no black ink
Keep all twenty separate, complete and rustic.
